mostWorthwhile.text: Following the mixed stream into the tail cloud was most worthwhile: the selective stripping clarified how the cloud could lose material while its larger body survived.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final two combinations were less engaging as decisions because each was the only offered action, even though they resolved the clump story.

surprise.text: I expected the tail and stream gas to mix or gather; instead, the stream stripped the cloud's edge while the larger cloud continued.

arbitrary.text: No action felt distinctly arbitrary; the combinations followed the gas and its surroundings, though I was sometimes unsure of the outcome.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see what becomes of the dense knot, although the forced choices at the end were less engaging.
